/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectMntrngReprtsDataList : 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 및 상담사 근무일정 및 휴가 목록 조회 * 2023.05.24 추가 - Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH VIEW_VCATN_APLY_HISTB AS (
) SELECT T1.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO AS MNTRNG_DATAA_NO , T1.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , T1.OGDP_DEPT_CD AS OGDP_DEPT_CD , T3.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN AS TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN , T1.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , T1.JOB_BGNG_TM AS BGNG_HR , T1.JOB_END_TM AS END_HR , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.WORK_YMD || T1.JOB_BGNG_TM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT , CASE WHEN SIGN(ABS(SUBSTR(T1.JOB_END_TM, 0, 2)) - ABS(SUBSTR(T1.JOB_BGNG_TM, 0, 2))) = -1 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.WORK_YMD || T1.JOB_END_TM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T1.WORK_YMD || T1.JOB_END_TM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS WORK_END_DT , CASE WHEN T2.COPA_INDEX_SN IS NOT NULL THEN '휴가' ELSE '' END AS CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN FROM AYC410 T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN VIEW_VCATN_APLY_HISTB T2 ON T2.USER_ID = T1.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN T2.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND T2.VCATN_END_YMD LEFT OUTER JOIN AYC300 T3 ON T3.WORK_YMD = T1.WORK_YMD AND T3.CNSLTNT_ID = T1.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID WHERE T1.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO}

WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT FROM DUAL ) /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectNotExistsByOutrcCnTnLog : 접속이력여부 확인 (사이버아웃리치) */ SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SAB930 /* 접속로그 */, TMP WHERE FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT - (INTERVAL '120' MINUTE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT + (INTERVAL '4' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS NOT_EXIST_NUM FROM DUAL

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectChatOpenTime : 채팅 오픈시간 조회 * 2023.05.22 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1/24 AS INQ_BGNG_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 4/24 AS INQ_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT T.CHTT_OPEN_DT AS CHTT_OPEN_DT /* 채팅오픈일시 */ , NVL(C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('MI', T.WORK_BGNG_DT, T.CHTT_OPEN_DT), 0) AS LATEN_TM /* 지각시각 (분) */ , CASE WHEN T.CHTT_OPEN_DT IS NULL THEN '결근' ELSE '' END AS CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN /* 채팅오픈시간내용 */ FROM ( SELECT A.CNSLTNT_ID AS ID , A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD AS CD , TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT AS WORK_BGNG_DT , A.CHG_DT AS CHTT_OPEN_DT /* 채팅오픈일시 */ FROM AYB202 A , TMP WHERE 1=1 AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD IN ('10', '15') AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN TMP.INQ_BGNG_DT AND TMP.INQ_END_DT ORDER BY A.CNSLTNT_ID, A.CHG_DT ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) T

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectChatCloseTime : 채팅 종료시간 조회 * 2023.05.23 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT A.CHTT_END_DT , A.CHRO_NO , A.CNSLTNT_ID , ABS(C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', A.CHTT_END_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT)) FROM AYB200 A , TMP WHERE 1=1 AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.CHTT_END_DT BETWEEN TMP.WORK_END_DT - 4/24 AND TMP.WORK_END_DT + 1 ORDER BY ABS(C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', A.CHTT_END_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT)) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectChatUnestaTime : 채팅 미개설시각 조회 */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT
CASE WHEN CHTT_UNESTA_VAL > 0 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MOD(CHTT_UNESTA_VAL, 86400), 'SSSSS'), 'HH24:MI') ELSE '' END AS CHTT_UNESTA_TM
FROM ( SELECT
T.WORK_DIFF_TIME - SUM(T.CHTT_DIFF_TIME) AS CHTT_UNESTA_VAL
T.WORK_DIFF_TIME - SUM(T.CHTT_DIFF_TIME) - (#{CONSTT_BREAK_HR} * 60) AS CHTT_UNESTA_VAL
FROM ( SELECT C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT) AS WORK_DIFF_TIME , CASE WHEN C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('MI', A.CHTT_END_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT) > 0 THEN C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, A.CHTT_END_DT) ELSE C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT) END AS CHTT_DIFF_TIME FROM AYB200 A , TMP WHERE 1=1 AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.CHTT_BGNG_DT BETWEEN TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT - 1/24 AND TMP.WORK_END_DT + 1/24 ) T GROUP BY T.WORK_DIFF_TIME )

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectRestTime : 휴게시간 조회 */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT #{CNSLTNT_ID} AS ID , TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT ID AS USER_ID , SUM(TERM_TIME) AS TOTAL_BREAK_TIME FROM ( SELECT ID , CD , TO_CHAR(CHG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CURR_CHG_DT , TO_CHAR(LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER(ORDER BY ID, CHG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS NEXT_CHG_DT , NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) AS TERM_TIME FROM ( SELECT TMP.ID ID, A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD CD, A.CHG_DT CHG_DT FROM AYB202 A , TMP WHERE 1=1 AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD IN ('10','11','14','15') AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = TMP.ID AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN TMP.WORK_BGNG_DT - 1/24 AND TMP.WORK_END_DT UNION ALL SELECT TMP.ID ID, '99' CD, TMP.WORK_END_DT CHG_DT FROM TMP ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) ) WHERE CD = '11' AND TERM_TIME != '0' GROUP BY ID

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectCnsltntLeaveTime : 상담사 퇴근시간 조회 */
WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT LVFFC_DT AS LVFFC_PRCS_DT /* 퇴근처리일시 */ FROM AYC495 /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */, TMP WHERE CONSTT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(LVFFC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.WORK_END_DT - (INTERVAL '4' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.WORK_END_DT + (INTERVAL '4' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY ABS(C##RG.SA_FN_DATEDIFF('SS', LVFFC_DT, TMP.WORK_END_DT)) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY /* TOP 1 */

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.insertMntrngReprts : 모니터링보고서 등록 */ INSERT INTO AYC400 ( MNTRNG_NO /* 모니터링번호 */ , WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , CRT_YMD /* 생성일자 */ , ONTJ_CNSLTNT_ID /* 작업중상담사아이디 */ , JOB_END_CNSLTNT_ID /* 작업종료상담사아이디 */ , JOB_RPT_CN /* 작업보고내용 */ , TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 업무보고상담사명암호화 */ , ACTNA_NM /* 액션명 (AS-IS: 2021년 11기 여자 청소년?)*/ , OGDP_DEPT_CD /* 소속부서코드 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES ( AYC400_SQ01.NEXTVAL /* 모니터링번호 */ , #{WRTR_ID} /* 작성자아이디 */ , #{CRT_YMD} /* 생성일자 */ , #{ONTJ_CNSLTNT_ID} /* 작업중상담사아이디 */ , #{JOB_END_CNSLTNT_ID} /* 작업종료상담사아이디 */ , #{JOB_RPT_CN} /* 작업보고내용 */ , #{TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM} /* 업무보고상담사명암호화 */ , #{ACTNA_NM} /* 액션명 */ , #{OGDP_DEPT_CD} /* 소속부서코드 */ , #{RGTR_ID} /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* 최초등록일시 */ , #{RGTR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , SYSDATE /* 최종등록일시 */ )
SELECT AYC400_SQ01.CURRVAL AS MNTRNG_NO FROM DUAL
mapper.select: /* isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectCyberDscsnList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ WITH TMP_BREAKTIME AS ( SELECT /* 상담사 휴게시간조회 가상테이블 */ CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , REST_HR /* 휴식시간 (초) */ FROM AYB220 /* 상담사상담중휴게시간 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} ) , TMP_OVRTIME_WORK_APLY AS ( SELECT /* 시간외근무신청내역 조회 가상테이블 */ CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ FROM AYB200 /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND OVTIME_WORK_YMD = #{CRT_YMD} /* 시간외근무일자 */ ) SELECT A.MNTRNG_NO /* 모니터링번호 */ , A.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO /* 모니터링데이터번호 */ , A.WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ , A.JOB_BGNG_TM /* 작업시작시각 */ , A.JOB_END_TM /* 작업종료시각 */ , A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID /* 업무보고상담사아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(W.FLNM_ENCPT) AS TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM /* 업무보고상담사명 */ , A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_RLS_NOCS, 0) AS NTABRD_RLS_NOCS /* 게시판공개건수 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_CLSDR_NOCS, 0) AS NTABRD_CLSDR_NOCS /* 비밀게시판건수 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_DAUM_NOCS, 0) AS NTABRD_DAUM_NOCS /* 다음게시판건수 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_NAVER_NOCS, 0) AS NTABRD_NAVER_NOCS /* 게시판네이버건수 */ , NVL(B.JAM_PSTG_NOCS, 0) AS JAM_PSTG_NOCS /* JAM게시건수 */ , NVL(B.CHTT_NOCS, 0) AS CHTT_NOCS /* 채팅건수 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_NOCS, 0) AS CMNT_NOCS /* 댓글건수 */ , NVL(B.NTABRD_SLRBT_PRFMNC_NOCS, 0) AS NTABRD_SLRBT_PRFMNC_NOCS /* 게시판솔로봇실적건수 */ , NVL(B.CMNT_SLRBT_PRFMNC_NOCS, 0) AS SLRBT_CMNT_NOCS /* 솔로봇댓글건수 */ , CASE WHEN E.CHRO_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OVTIME_WORK_APLY_YN /* 시간외근무신청여부 */ , A.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN /* 채팅오픈시간내용 */ , A.CHTT_END_TM /* 채팅종료시각 */ , NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LVFFC_PRCS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS'), '-') AS LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , A.CHTT_UNESTA_TM /* 채팅미개설시각 */ , CASE WHEN A.CONSTT_BREAK_HR IS NULL THEN ( SELECT TRUNC(MAX(REST_HR) / 60) FROM TMP_BREAKTIME WHERE CNSLTNT_ID = B.CNSLTNT_ID ) ELSE A.CONSTT_BREAK_HR END AS CONSTT_BREAK_HR /* 상담자휴게시간 */ , A.OGDP_DEPT_CD /* 소속부서코드 */ , B.ETC_DTL_CN AS ETC_DTL_CN /* 기타상세내용 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYC300 B /* 업무보고서 */ , AYC100 C /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , ( SELECT /* 상담사 출퇴근체크 가상테이블 */ CONSTT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(LVFFC_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LVFFC_YMD /* 퇴근일자 */ , LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , LVFFC_DT AS LVFFC_CHK_DT /* 퇴근체크일시 */ , INDEX_SN AS TASKWK_SCHDL_SN /* 업무일정일련번호 */ FROM AYC495 /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ WHERE 1=1 ) D , TMP_OVRTIME_WORK_APLY E , SAA200 U /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 W /* 종사자 */ ON U.ENFSN_NO = W.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD(+) /* AYC300: 근무일자 */ AND A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN = B.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN(+) /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ AND A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID = B.CNSLTNT_ID(+) /* AYC300: 상담사아이디 */ AND B.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = C.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN(+) /* AYC100: 업무일정일련번호 */ AND C.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = D.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN(+) /* AYC420: 업무일정일련번호 */ AND C.USER_ID = D.CNSLTNT_ID(+) /* AYC420: 상담사아이디 */ AND B.CNSLTNT_ID = E.CNSLTNT_ID(+) /* AYB200: 상담사아이디 */ AND U.USER_ID = A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID /* 사용자아이디 */ AND W.OGDP_DEPT_CD = '324' /* 소속부서코드: 사이버상담(324) 으로 고정 */ AND A.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} /* 모니터링번호 */ ORDER BY A.JOB_BGNG_TM, A.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO

/* isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectOutreachList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ WITH TMP_BREAKTIME AS ( SELECT /* 상담사 휴게시간조회 가상테이블 */ CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , REST_HR /* 휴식시간 (초) */ FROM AYB220 /* 상담사상담중휴게시간 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(BGNG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} ) , TMP_OVRTIME_WORK_APLY AS ( SELECT /* 시간외근무신청내역 조회 가상테이블 */ CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ FROM AYB200 /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND OVTIME_WORK_YMD = #{CRT_YMD} /* 시간외근무일자 */ ) SELECT A.MNTRNG_NO /* 모니터링번호 */ , A.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO /* 모니터링데이터번호 */ , A.WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ , A.JOB_BGNG_TM /* 작업시작시각 */ , A.JOB_END_TM /* 작업종료시각 */ , A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID /* 업무보고상담사아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(W.FLNM_ENCPT) AS TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM /* 업무보고상담사명 */ , A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ , NVL(B.MSNGR_NOCS, 0) AS OUTRC_MSNGR_NOCS /* 아웃리치메신저건수 */ , NVL(B.CMNT_DSCSN_NOCS, 0) AS OUTRC_CMNT_DSCSN_NOCS/* 아웃리치댓글상담건수 */ , NVL(B.PR_NOCS, 0) AS OUTRC_PR_NOCS /* 아웃리치홍보건수 */ , CASE WHEN E.CHRO_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OVTIME_WORK_APLY_YN /* 시간외근무신청여부 */ , A.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN /* 채팅오픈시간내용 */ , A.CHTT_OPEN_DT /* 채팅오픈일시 */ , A.CHTT_END_TM /* 채팅종료시각 */ , A.CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ , NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LVFFC_PRCS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS'), '-') AS LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , A.CHTT_UNESTA_TM /* 채팅미개설시각 */ , CASE WHEN A.CONSTT_BREAK_HR IS NULL THEN ( SELECT TRUNC(MAX(REST_HR) / 60) FROM TMP_BREAKTIME WHERE CNSLTNT_ID = B.CNSLTNT_ID ) ELSE A.CONSTT_BREAK_HR END AS CONSTT_BREAK_HR /* 상담자휴게시간 */ , A.CONSTT_BREAK_HR /* 상담자휴게시간 */ , A.OGDP_DEPT_CD /* 소속부서코드 */ , B.ETC_DTL_CN AS ETC_DTL_CN /* 기타상세내용 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYC300 B /* 업무보고서 */ , AYC100 C /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , ( SELECT /* 상담사 출퇴근체크 가상테이블 */ CONSTT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(LVFFC_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LVFFC_YMD /* 퇴근일자 */ , LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , LVFFC_DT AS LVFFC_CHK_DT /* 퇴근체크일시 */ , INDEX_SN AS TASKWK_SCHDL_SN /* 업무일정일련번호 */ FROM AYC495 /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ WHERE 1=1 ) D , TMP_OVRTIME_WORK_APLY E , SAA200 U /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 W /* 종사자 */ ON U.ENFSN_NO = W.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD(+) /* AYC300: 근무일자 */ AND /* isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectMobileList - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT A.MNTRNG_NO /* 모니터링번호 */ , A.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO /* 모니터링데이터번호 */ , A.WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ , A.JOB_BGNG_TM /* 작업시작시각 */ , A.JOB_END_TM /* 작업종료시각 */ , A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID /* 업무보고상담사아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(W.FLNM_ENCPT) AS TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_NM /* 업무보고상담사명 */ , A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ , NVL(B.DSCSN_NOCS, 0) AS DSCSN_NOCS /* 상담건수 */ , NVL(B.CRISIS_LINK_NOCS, 0) AS CRISIS_LINK_NOCS /* 위기연계건수 */ , NVL(B.CRISIS_NOCS, 0) AS CRISIS_NOCS /* 위기건수 */ , NVL(B.LINK_NOCS, 0) AS LINK_NOCS /* 연계건수 */ , NVL(B.AFTFCT_MNG_NOCS, 0) AS AFTFCT_MNG_NOCS /* 사후관리건수 */ , NVL(B.OPEN_CHRO_DSCSN_NOCS, 0) AS OPEN_CHRO_DSCSN_NOCS /* 오픈채팅방상담건수 */ , B.OVTIME_WORK_APLY_HR /* 시간이외근무신청시간 */ , CASE WHEN B.OVTIME_WORK_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OVTIME_WORK_APLY_YN /* 시간외근무신청여부 */ , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(B.CHTT_ATENDB_DT, 'HH24:MI') IS NULL THEN A.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN ELSE TO_CHAR(B.CHTT_ATENDB_DT, 'HH24:MI') END AS CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN /* 채팅오픈시간내용 */ , TO_CHAR(C.ATENDB_DT, 'HH24:MI') AS ATENDB_PRPARE_HR /* 출근준비시간 */ , NVL(TO_CHAR(C.LVFFC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS'), '-') AS LVFFC_DT /* 퇴근일시 */ , B.BREAK_HR /* 휴게시간 */ , NVL(TRUNC((B.OVTIME_WORK_DT - B.WORK_END_DT) * 24 * 60), 0) AS OVTIME_WORK_TM /* 시간외근무시간 */ , NVL(TRUNC((B.CHTT_ATENDB_DT - B.WORK_BGNG_DT) * 24 * 60), 0) AS LATEN_TM /* 지각시간 */ , NVL(TRUNC((C.ATENDB_DT - B.WORK_BGNG_DT) * 24 * 60), 0) AS DCLZ_LATEN_TM /* 지각시간 (근태기록) */ , A.OGDP_DEPT_CD /* 소속부서코드 */ , B.ETC_DTL_CN AS ETC_DTL_CN /* 기타상세내용 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYC300 B /* 업무보고서 */ , AYC495 C /* 모바일상담원퇴근관리 */ , SAA200 U /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 W /* 종사자 */ ON U.ENFSN_NO = W.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD(+) AND A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN = B.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN(+) AND A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID = B.CNSLTNT_ID(+) AND B.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = C.INDEX_SN(+) AND U.USER_ID = A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID AND W.OGDP_DEPT_CD = '326' /* 소속부서코드: 모바일상담(326) 으로 고정 */ AND A.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} /* 모니터링번호 */ ORDER BY A.JOB_BGNG_TM, A.MNTRNG_DATAA_NO

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectOpenChroNocs : 오픈채팅방 답글 및 고민글 등록 건수 조회 (모바일상담) */ NVL(COUNT(RETE_ESNTAL_NO), 0) AS OPEN_CHRO_RETE_NOCS /* 오픈채팅방답글건수 */ , NVL(COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO), 0) AS OPEN_CHRO_STOFPR_NOCS /* 오픈채팅방고민글건수 */ FROM ( SELECT C.RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , AYE120 C /* 사이버상담답글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO(+) /* 게시글고유번호 */ AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = C.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' /* 게시글유형구분코드: 18 (오픈채팅 - tbl_openchatting) */ AND A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID = C.FRST_RGTR_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(B.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = A.WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 */ AND A.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} /* 모니터링번호 */ ) T

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectDclzMngSttsList : 근태관리 목록 조회 * 2023.05.24 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */ SELECT T1.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(T3.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_FLNM , T3.OGDP_DEPT_CD AS OGDP_DEPT_CD , CASE WHEN T1.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN LIKE '%지각%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LATEN_YN , CASE WHEN T1.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN LIKE '%결근%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ABSENC_YN , CASE WHEN T1.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN NOT LIKE '%휴가%' AND LVFFC_PRCS_DT IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS UNLGT_YN FROM AYC410 T1 /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , SAA200 T2 /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 T3 /* 종사자 */ WHERE T1.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} AND T2.USER_ID = T1.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID AND T3.ENFSN_NO = T2.ENFSN_NO

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectCrisisLinkNocs : 위기 및 연계 건수 조회 */ NVL(COUNT(*), 0) AS CRISIS_LINK_NOCS /* 위기 및 연계 건수 */ FROM ( SELECT INDEX_SN, CONSTT_ID FROM AYA120 A /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01', '02', '05', '06', '07', '24', '31') /* 사이버상담 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} /* 생성일자 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부 */ AND A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT INDEX_SN, CONSTT_ID FROM AYA120 A /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('91') /* 모바일상담 */ AND TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} /* 생성일자 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부 */ AND A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT INDEX_SN, CONSTT_ID FROM AYA190 A /* 사후관리 */ WHERE BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('91') /* 모바일상담 */ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} /* 생성일자 */ ) CR

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectThptyPvsnHistbNocs : 제3자 제공내역 건수 조회 (모바일상담) */ NVL(SUM(YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 청소년상담복지센터_직접의뢰건수 */ , NVL(SUM(FAM_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS FAM_DRCT_RQST_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 가족_직접의뢰건수 */ , NVL(SUM(DT_CACE_SHELTR_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS DT_CACE_SHELTR_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 일시보호소쉼터_직접의뢰건수 */ , NVL(SUM(EMRG_RESC_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS EMRG_RESC_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 긴급구조_직접의뢰건수 */ , NVL(SUM(LEADER_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS LEADER_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 지도자_직접의뢰건수 */ , NVL(SUM(ETC_SPCLTY_INST_DRCT_RQST_VAL), 0) AS ETC_SPCLTY_INST_DRCT_RQST_NOCS /* 기타전문기관_직접의뢰건수 */ FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS YNGBGS_DSCSN_WLFAR_CNTER_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 청소년상담복지센터_직접의뢰값 */ , CASE WHEN FAM_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FAM_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 가족_직접의뢰값 */ , CASE WHEN DT_CACE_SHELTR_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DT_CACE_SHELTR_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 일시보호소쉼터_직접의뢰값 */ , CASE WHEN EMRG_RESC_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EMRG_RESC_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 긴급구조_직접의뢰값 */ , CASE WHEN LEADER_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LEADER_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 지도자_직접의뢰값 */ , CASE WHEN ETC_SPCLTY_INST_RQST_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ETC_SPCLTY_INST_DRCT_RQST_VAL /* 기타전문기관_직접의뢰값 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYA120 B /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE 1=1 AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '91' /* 모바일상담 */ AND B.DSCSN_YMD = A.WORK_YMD /* 상담일자 */ AND A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID = B.CONSTT_ID /* 상담자아이디 */ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부 */ AND A.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} /* 모니터링번호 */ ) T

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectTaskwkReprtsWrtrList : 업무보고서 작성자 목록 */ B.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ , CASE WHEN B.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS TASKWK_REPRTS_WRT_YN /* 업무보고서작성여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(W.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_FLNM /* 상담사성명 */ FROM AYC410 A /* 일간 모니터링 보고서 데이터 */ , AYC300 B /* 업무보고서 */ , SAA200 U /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 W /* 종사자 */ ON U.ENFSN_NO = W.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.WORK_YMD = B.WORK_YMD(+) /* AYC300: 근무일자 */ AND A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN = B.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN(+) /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ AND A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID = B.CNSLTNT_ID(+) /* AYC300: 상담사아이디 */ AND U.USER_ID = A.TASKWK_RPT_CNSLTNT_ID /* SAA200: 사용자아이디 */ AND A.CHTT_OPEN_HR_CN <> '휴가' AND A.MNTRNG_NO = #{MNTRNG_NO} /* 모니터링번호 */ ORDER BY A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN

/* isry.couns.mngr.mntrngReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectCrisisLinkBbsctt - 개발지원팀 이태호 */
SELECT INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD FROM AYA120/* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} /* 근무일자 */ AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01', '02', '05', '06', '07', '24', '31', '91') AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL ORDER BY INDEX_SN ASC

WITH TMP AS ( SELECT A.INDEX_SN /* 색인일련번호 */ , A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분코드 */ FROM AYA120 A /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{CRT_YMD} /* 근무일자 */ AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01', '02', '05', '06', '07', '24', '31', '91') AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 삭제여부 */ AND A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IS NOT NULL ) SELECT /* isry.couns.mngr.mnngtrReprtsMng.mapper.MntrngReprtsMngMapper.selectCrisisLinkTypeNocs - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '10') AS GNRL_NOCS /* 일반건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('04', '05', '06', '07', '08', '09')) AS VIOLNC_NOCS /* 폭력건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '02') AS SUCDE_NOCS /* 자살건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '01') AS PREGNA_NOCS /* 임신건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '03') AS LVM_NOCS /* 가출건수 */ , (SELECT COUNT(INDEX_SN) FROM TMP WHERE CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '99') AS ETC_NOCS /* 기타건수 */ FROM DUAL
